name: saas_deny_or_bypass
description: A tenant predicate under OR proves nothing.

request.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 OR true LIMIT 10

reasons.message: app.orders (as orders) has no provable tenant predicate on orders.tenant_id in the same SELECT
reasons.hint: Add `WHERE orders.tenant_id = $1` as a top-level AND condition inside the same SELECT that reads app.orders (not in an outer query, not under OR/NOT, not in the ON of the preserved side of an outer join).

reasons.message: parameter $1 is not a tenant placeholder, so its value is unknown
reasons.hint: Use $n placeholders only as the value of a tenant predicate (e.g. o.tenant_id = $1); write other values as literals.
